auth_enrollment_grants_purpose_recovery_.name: auth_enrollment_grants_purpose_recovery_relation_check
auth_enrollment_grants_purpose_recovery_.value: ("auth_enrollment_grants"."purpose" = 'BOOTSTRAP' AND "auth_enrollment_grants"."recovery_code_id" IS NULL) OR ("auth_enrollment_grants"."purpose" = 'RECOVERY' AND "auth_enrollment_grants"."recovery_code_id" IS NOT NULL)

auth_enrollment_grants_state_exclusive_c.name: auth_enrollment_grants_state_exclusive_check
auth_enrollment_grants_state_exclusive_c.value: NOT ("auth_enrollment_grants"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "auth_enrollment_grants"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

auth_recovery_codes_state_exclusive_chec.name: auth_recovery_codes_state_exclusive_check
auth_recovery_codes_state_exclusive_chec.value: NOT ("auth_recovery_codes"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "auth_recovery_codes"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

webauthn_challenges_purpose_enrollment_g.name: webauthn_challenges_purpose_enrollment_grant_relation_check
webauthn_challenges_purpose_enrollment_g.value: ("webauthn_challenges"."purpose" = 'REGISTRATION' AND "webauthn_challenges"."enrollment_grant_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("webauthn_challenges"."purpose" = 'AUTHENTICATION' AND "webauthn_challenges"."enrollment_grant_id" IS NULL)

journal_entries_posted_at_check.name: journal_entries_posted_at_check
journal_entries_posted_at_check.value: ("journal_entries"."status" = 'DRAFT' AND "journal_entries"."posted_at" IS NULL) OR ("journal_entries"."status" = 'POSTED' AND "journal_entries"."posted_at" IS NOT NULL)

journal_entries_source_check.name: journal_entries_source_check
journal_entries_source_check.value: ("journal_entries"."source_type" IS NULL AND "journal_entries"."source_ref" IS NULL) OR ("journal_entries"."source_type" IS NOT NULL AND "journal_entries"."source_ref" IS NOT NULL)
